title: Dolan's USO database shows EM interference patterns

tellings.quote: I noticed about 10% of all the cases involved EM interference.

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he built a collection of reports of unidentified submerged objects, strange things seen in or coming out of the world's oceans, going back to 1825, with help from someone called Tracy. Dolan says that about one in ten of those cases involved electromagnetic interference, meaning radios, compasses or electrical systems acting up nearby. To him, that pattern suggests the objects share some real physical effect.
